assertions.assertion: Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was medically necessary
Patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
Known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
Service ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes
Mobile cardiac telemetry is appropriate to assess whether symptomatic episodes are cardiac in origin
Patient's established diagnoses of I25.10 and I34.0
